name: Chicken, Kale, Grapefruit & Mint Salad with Thai Peanut Dressing

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 grapefruits
3 bunches kale
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin and white pith from grapefruits. Slice between the membranes to release segments, transfer to a small bowl, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl, along with oil, peanut butter, vinegar, honey, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp natural peanut butter
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the chicken and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side; remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with grapefruit segments, grilled chicken, and peanuts. Enjoy!
